chunks.subject: AP Seminar
chunks.title: End-of-Course Exam Part A (15 points) — Set 2
chunks.content: AP Seminar End-of-Course Exam Part A, 15 points, scored on a source passage across three questions (rows scored independently by best-fit). Question 1 — Argument, main idea, or thesis [0–3]. Question 2 — Explain line of reasoning [0–6]. Question 3 — Evaluate effectiveness of the evidence [0–6]. Set 2 uses a different source passage than Set 1; same task template and scoring. Common failure: summarizing instead of stating the argument (Q1); listing reasons without explaining their connections (Q2); describing rather than evaluating evidence effectiveness (Q3).
